LESSON: SAFETY IN THE ENVIRONMENT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Safety in the environment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Safety in the environment, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you observe safety?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Safety in the environment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility:Diligence as learner tells what to do when they meet strangers.

● Integrity: discipline as learner cleans the working areas after an activity.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety and security – learners enhance safety and security as they learn how to identify strangers and what to do when they meet

them

Disaster and risk reduction- as learners identify safe places and activities in the school.

Link to other learning area:

Learners learn safety precautions as they sign poems related to safety.

Suggested Learning Resources

Local environment, environmental natural and man-made structures, relevant digital devices, signed video clips.
